prompt: A string lives in a bigger array. Follow what `strlen` and `sizeof` each measure.
explain: `strlen` walks until the first `'\0'`, which is now at index 1, so it reports 1. `sizeof buf` is the size of the whole array, 8, and says nothing about the text. Nothing erased `'t'`: the bytes after the terminator are still there, they are just no longer part of the string.
